questions: How many oxidized, etched and Ti-doped devices did you measure, and how many showed a field-free diode? The pristine count of ten is on p. 4.
Why were the others set aside, if any were?
Which ranges did you measure beyond the ones shown: more sweeps per condition, field values between those in Fig. 4, and temperatures for Device 14?
What does the second-best device look like? Device 14 (Figs. S7 to S11) partly answers this; could you show its eta statistics as in Figs. 3d,e and 4?
What is the magnet's residual field at nominal zero after the Fig. 4 series and the 1 T field cooling (Figs. S8, S9), and was it measured?
Did you measure Device 16, or a pristine device, at the 0.1 to 0.2 T out-of-plane fields that fix the polarity in Device 13?
How is the onset current picked in multi-peak curves such as Fig. 2b, and what excitation and sweep rate were used? Fig. S3 lists "Iac = 10 μA" against a critical current near 37 μA (p. 5).

Which device is which? Page 5 gives eta from −30.86% to 17.07% for Device 12, Fig. S3 calls Device 12 "Fig. 2 in the main text" (Device 11 on p. 5), and Fig. S4 gives those values for "Device 13 after successive oxidation stages".
